render_novel_views: render novel view images from a trained KeypointNeRF model given camera poses and a batch
render_video: render a 360-degree video from a trained KeypointNeRF model using a data loader
compute_test_metric: compute PSNR and SSIM metrics between rendered and ground truth images using Kornia
query_geometry_and_color: query the KeypointNeRF model for alpha, SDF, and RGB at 3D points given camera parameters
forward_training: run a forward training pass through KeypointNeRF and compute reconstruction loss with VGG loss
